- Marcus: deliver 7-day redacted sample by Tue EOD (attached) and full 30-day redacted bundle by Fri EOD. (attachments: log-samples-redacted.zip)
- Hannah: post redaction checklist to shared Drive and confirm redaction rules by Wed noon.
- Irene: provide CAIQ appendix final by Wed EOD and produce an auditor access checklist (how to request role + required contact info).

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3Cnovaforge-sig (folder for CAIQ + logs)
HubSpot record: HS-48291 (Novaforge opportunity)

Please reply if anything above is incorrect. If not, Marcus will upload the sample to the Drive folder and I’ll post the final CAIQ appendix.

Thanks,
Irene

Hi Irene — thanks for the notes and quick turnaround. The sample looks good at a glance. Two quick follow-ups: 

1) Auditor access: can you confirm the exact scope of the temporary role (read-only, which S3 prefixes, CloudWatch read-only)? Our third-party assessor asks for an IAM policy example they can review.
2) Rotation/retention: do you have a standard retention window on the exported logs we should document in the SIG appendix? Novaforge policies require a minimum 90-day retention for audit artifacts.

If you can paste an example IAM policy or a quick JSON snippet into the Drive folder, that would let our assessor pre-review. Otherwise we’re happy to proceed with the planned access request timing.
